summary: The cached re-adjudication stopped before writing a report because its reconstructed audit namespace omitted the persistent-grasp occlusion-gap and bridge-coverage fields used in summary serialization.
evidence: The exception occurred before the output report write.
The immutable input audit and per-frame metrics remain unchanged.
The missing values are present in the original audit config and can be copied without recomputing any image metric.
lessons: Cached adjudication must reconstruct the complete summary ABI, including descriptive physical-contract fields that are not themselves threshold values.
limitations: No re-adjudicated report was produced by this attempt.
next_actions: Populate the two missing fields from the immutable source report and rerun in a new directory.
